Ballot Drop Locations

Ballots will be mailed starting October 2, 2026 to all active registered voters. (There is no requirement to apply for an absentee ballot in Colorado.)

Return Your Ballot: Send your voted ballot back by mail with paid postage, or deliver it to any one of our 24-hour ballot drop box locations below by 7:00 p.m. on November 3, 2026. No postage is required to use a 24-hour ballot box.

Track Your Ballot: Use our free BallotTrax service to check the status of your ballot online, and to sign up to receive text, email or phone messages when your ballot has been mailed to you, when it's been received by Arapahoe County Elections, and when it has been accepted.

BALLOT BOXES OPEN from October 2, 2026 to November 3, 2026 at 7:00 P.M.
Enter your address to find your nearest ballot drop-off location.
